real_defects.issue: With TRUST_PROXY=true the per-IP rate limits (/api/ask 20/min, /api/handoff 5/min) keyed on the LEFT-hand X-Forwarded-For entry, which the client writes; a proxy appends the real address on the right. Forging it gave every request a fresh bucket, so /api/ask (which can spend the deployer's model key) and handoff (which forwards email to the webhook) were unlimited. Repro: 21 asks with XFF '10.0.0.<i>, 203.0.113.7' all 200. Fix: split(',').pop(); test 'behind a proxy the rate limit keys on the hop the proxy appended'.

Same left-hand X-Forwarded-For key in waitlist-keeper, einvoice-preflight, help-keeper, proposal-maker, flag-keeper, form-inbox, visit-keeper, slot-keeper, link-keeper, support-desk, survey-keeper, feedback-board and babysitting-business-kit (server, invoices-server, waitlist-server); five of them read the header with no TRUST_PROXY gate at all, so even a direct caller picked its own bucket. All switched to the right-hand entry; platform/ci/test_xff_rightmost.py fails any future copy (runs on every venture PR through unwired_checks.py). Remaining, not done here: the ungated five still trust the header when deployed with no proxy in front; gating them on TRUST_PROXY changes their deploy config (fly/render set it) and wants its own run.
